# montecarlo_airflow_callbacks_key (Data Source)

An Airflow callbacks key is a key id and secret an Airflow environment reports its DAG and task runs to Monte Carlo with, scoped to one `airflow` ETL container. The secret is returned only when the key is created. A container can hold several keys, so create the new one before deleting the old one when rotating.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_id` (String) Id of the integration key, as returned when it is created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) When the key was created.
- `description` (String) What this key is for.
- `etl_container_id` (String) The Airflow ETL container the key reports to. Null when the key names no warehouse or container, several of them, or one you cannot see. A key created outside this API with no scope at all is accepted for any of your account's resources, so replace it with a scoped one.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the key.
- `mcd_id` (String) Key id to present, as the `x-mcd-id` header or a client's `mcd_id` setting. The same value as `id`.
